Module.Name: gaia-iml
Module.Description: Gaia DR3 variable star detection using IntegratedML Custom Models + AI Hub. Scans 20 gzipped epoch photometry files, ingests flux and per-epoch quality stats into IRIS, then scores every source with SQL PREDICT() against two custom NGBoost IRISModel regressors that predict ESA's own epoch reject fraction and its uncertainty. ~11s end-to-end. InterSystems Employee Programming Challenge #1.
